milestones.summary: I work on Instant Bloomberg’s messaging backend. Changes to Python Kafka consumers reduced message latency by 40% and improved throughput by 25% through batching, encoding and compression.
details: Developed backend features for infrastructure supporting 200,000+ mobile daily active users with 99.99% uptime.
Built real-time user event synchronization with Redis and distributed messaging, and audio messaging APIs with compliance intervention.
Led the migration from physical to virtual clusters to improve deployment and scaling.

milestones.summary: Led iOS development, then moved into backend and data engineering in my final year. Built event pipelines and a recipe creation service that streamed responses to mobile clients.
details: Worked on the iOS app for a recipe-sharing platform with a global audience; mentored four developers on APIs and client-server design.
Built cross-platform event ingestion and enrichment with Snowplow, dbt and Redshift.
Used Python, Flask and Server-Sent Events to display generated recipe content as it arrived, rather than waiting for a complete response.
milestones.stack: Swift · Python · Flask · Snowplow · dbt · Redshift

milestones.summary: Co-architected the API gateway and data localization strategy for the China market, reducing API and CDN timeout issues by 65% through infrastructure changes.
details: Focused on the reliability of requests between clients in China and Farfetch’s services.
Worked across gateway routing and data localization to reduce cross-border network problems.
